audit.method: Direct model translation followed by a complete source-target editorial reading of quest records 100–134: all titles, descriptions, objectives, and completion dialogue. Every quest type, target query, item or location identifier, dependency, reward, cancel flag, and other technical field was compared byte-for-byte with English. Character voices and control tokens were retained, gendered player-address wording was avoided, and canonical glossary terms were applied throughout. The full-locale final audits remain pending.

records.english: Building/Feeding Animals/Robin, the local carpenter, lives north of town. In exchange for raw materials and money, she'll construct new buildings on your farm. If you build a silo, you can start harvesting your own grass with the scythe, and store it to feed your animals./Build a Silo./Silo/-1/100/-1/true
